presentation.label: GALACTIC
presentation.summary: Airwindows' lush Galactic reverb, its wet path boosted for pedal levels.
presentation.overview: Airwindows' lush Galactic reverb, its wet path boosted for pedal levels.
highlights: Play a short chord and listen to the modulated stereo reverb tail.
usage: Add Galactic from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Play a short chord and listen to the modulated stereo reverb tail.
Use the page buttons to reach the remaining controls.

controls.name: Mix
controls.doc: Dry/wet crossfade. Renamed from 'DryWet' so every effect in the pack ends with the same control. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.

load.conditions: The effect descriptor declares this cost. Audio load on the pedal is unmeasured.

tests.summary: Ziddle passed the loader check and rendered 22,050 stereo frames. The compiled file passed the stock-code scan and MS-70CDR size limits. Hardware untested.
